The **University of St Andrews** ([Scots](/wiki/Scots_language "Scots language"): *University o St Andras*, [Scottish Gaelic](/wiki/Scottish_Gaelic_language "Scottish Gaelic language"): *Oilthigh Chill Rìmhinn*;[[6]](#cite_note-6) abbreviated as **St And** in [post-nominals](/wiki/Post-nominals "Post-nominals")[[a]](#cite_note-7)) is a [public](/wiki/Public_university "Public university") [research university](/wiki/Research_university "Research university") in the town of [St Andrews](/wiki/St_Andrews "St Andrews") in [Scotland](/wiki/Scotland "Scotland"). St Andrews was founded in 1413 when the [Avignon](/wiki/Avignon_Pope "Avignon Pope") [Antipope Benedict XIII](/wiki/Antipope_Benedict_XIII "Antipope Benedict XIII") issued a [papal bull](/wiki/Papal_bull "Papal bull") to a small founding group of [Augustinian](/wiki/Augustinians "Augustinians") clergy. That work introduced the Clauser–Horne (CH) inequality as the first fully general experimental requirement set by local realism. He was born in [Yongding County](/wiki/Yongding_District,_Longyan "Yongding District, Longyan"), Fujian into a [Hakka](/wiki/Hakka "Hakka") family whose ancestral roots are usually traced to [Xingning, Guangdong](/wiki/Xingning,_Guangdong "Xingning, Guangdong").[[1]](#cite_note-Li_2016-1) In August 1973 he went to Yongding County as a [sent-down youth](/wiki/Sent-down_youth "Sent-down youth"). In November 1976, he participated in the construction of the Shixiangtan Hydroelectric Dam. After the resumption of the [National College Entrance Examination](/wiki/Gaokao "Gaokao"), he gained admission to the [Xiamen University](/wiki/Xiamen_University "Xiamen University") school of economics; he studied finance. He obtained a bachelor and a master's degree in 1982 and 1984 respectively, and a Ph.D. degree through part-time studies in 1998.[[1]](#cite_note-Li_2016-1) After graduating he began work in [Xiamen](/wiki/Xiamen "Xiamen") as a researcher for the special economic zone.[[2]](#cite_note-:1-2)

In July 1984, Wang Yishi, the vice governor of Fujian, came to the home of He Lifeng's mentor Deng Ziji and asked Deng to recommend a student to support the construction of the Xiamen Special Economic Zone. He Lifeng was recommended to become a [cadre](/wiki/Cadre_system_of_the_Chinese_Communist_Party "Cadre system of the Chinese Communist Party") of the Xiamen Special Economic Zone Economic Research Institute and thus began his career in the government. In October, he began working for the Xiamen municipal government, beginning his career in politics.[[3]](#cite_note-:2-3)
